CLI

Command the build

The MDL command line keeps authoring tight: check source, format files, preview locally, and build static output from one project config.

Quickstart

Start from a project

Run these commands from an MDL project folder such as examples/mdl-complete-website.

../../bin/mdl check
        ../../bin/mdl format --check
        ../../bin/mdl serve
        ../../bin/mdl build
Reference

CLI commands

Command

Purpose

When to use it

mdl check

Validates MDL syntax without writing files.

Run before commits, demos, or batch builds.

mdl format

Rewrites MDL source using the project formatter.

Use when authoring or cleaning up page files.

mdl format --check

Reports files that need formatting without changing them.

Use in CI or review workflows.

mdl serve

Starts a local live preview for the configured project.

Use while editing pages, CSS, scripts, and assets.

mdl build

Compiles every configured page into static HTML output.

Use before publishing or handing off static files.
Recipes

Common command recipes

Preview this website

cd examples/mdl-complete-website
            ../../bin/mdl serve

Build this website

cd examples/mdl-complete-website
            ../../bin/mdl build

Build one explicit page

cargo run -p mdl-cli -- build examples/sample/pricing.mdl --style pricing.css --title "MDL Pricing"

Preview one explicit page

cargo run -p mdl-cli -- serve examples/sample/pricing.mdl --style pricing.css --title "MDL Pricing"
